New sections are added at the top; old sections are never edited.* --- ## 2026-02-06 - Initial Strategy ### Vision Blueprint is the system of record for design systems - where design decisions are created, reviewed, versioned, and referenced with confidence over time. ### Current Focus **Phase 1: Token Management Foundation** - Core token CRUD with hierarchical groups - Theme system (Light/Dark value switching) - Release versioning for production snapshots ### Key Bets 1. **Governance matters** - Teams need approval workflows, not just storage 2. **Tokens are the atomic unit** - Everything else (components, patterns) derives from tokens 3. **Reference library differentiates** - Peer comparison and best practices add unique value 4. **AI assists, humans decide** - Recommendations surface options; designers choose ### Not Doing (v1) - Real-time collaboration (live cursors, presence) - Offline-first mode - Mobile native apps - Dark mode UI (light-only for v1) - Theme inheritance resolution - Audit logging - Natural language editing - Design system Q&A chat --- ## Change Log
